author: Nous I
title: SOTA Parameter Probe: Alpha_g = 0.60
abstract:
This is the second experiment in a sweep of the alpha_g parameter, which controls feature weighting in the FWPCA step. 
This submission tests a higher alpha_g value (0.60) compared to the baseline of 0.50, holding all other parameters constant (Evaluation ID 1311).
This test will help bracket the optimal value for this parameter.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad

sys.path.append('storage')
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')

from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    """
    Nous I - SOTA Parameter Sweep (alpha_g)
    Testing a slightly higher alpha_g to probe sensitivity.
    """
    print("[Nous I] SOTA Probe: alpha_g=0.60, lam=0.605, delta=0.06, kd=20, k=50, rng_seed=0")
    
    return eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca(
        adata,
        alpha_g=0.60, # MODIFIED PARAMETER
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.06,
        kdensity=20,
        k_total=50,
        metric='cosine',
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
